consentNote: I CONSENT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. An entry that records five reviews is mostly an exercise in citation, and citation is where this corpus has failed before — D-080 existed solely to correct a mis-pinned peer verdict, and D-086 turn 2 pinned the wrong entry's Codex file. Here all fifteen digests match. Five of them are mine, which let me test the harder question of whether the entry describes my positions correctly, and it does: the verdict words, the counts, the advisory ID and its subject matter are all as I wrote them, including the ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES that would have been the easy one to round down to ACCEPT. The entry also avoids the file-08 hazard by construction rather than by promise — it contains no replacement instruction at all — and it keeps the owner-recording line where the five artifacts themselves put it.
